Bihar Board Class 10th Matric Exam Result, Scrutiny and Compartment Result 2026
Post Date / Update : 23 May 2026 | 11:16 AM
Short Information

Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) Bihar Board release the results for the Class 10th Matriculation Annual Board Exam 2026. The answer key has already been released for enrolled candidates. Candidates can check it and verify their answers. Candidates with objections to any answers can submit them within the deadline and time specified by the board. After the objection process is complete, the BSEB will declare the final result. Candidates will be able to check their results/marks by entering their roll code and roll number on the official website. The official result 29 March 2026.

Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB)

BSEB Bihar Board Class 10th Matric Result 2026

Bihar Board BSEB Xth Results 2026:  Short Details of Notification

Important Dates

  • Class 10 Matric Exam : February 2026
  • Class 10 Matric Result Available : 29 March 2026 at 01:15 PM
  • Class 10 Compartment Form Available : 01-07 April 2026
  • Class 10 Compartment Result Available : 23/05/2026 at 4 PM

Exam Conducted By

  • BSEB Patna – Bihar School of Examination Board Will be Conducted the Examination of Matric Class 10th Examination 2026.

How to Check Bihar Board 10th Result 2026

  • In this year 2026 around 15.50 Lakhs+ (Approx) are registered in Bihar Board Matric High School Class 10 Exam.
  • This year Bihar Board Matric Class 10 Exam was held from February 2026.
  • This year the result of Bihar Board High School Class 10 examination will be released on 29 March 2026 at 01:15 PM.
  • What documents / details will be required to check the result of Bihar Board Matric class 10 exam this year.
  • To check the result of Bihar Board Class 10 Matric Examination 2026, the candidate will need the roll code and roll number.
  • Website to Check BSEB 10th Results 2026 : Official Website Direct Link Will be Also Available at SarkariResult.Com to Check Bihar Board Results 2026
  • Candidates who do not have roll number and roll code available or not known can check it in their admit card or can check from their school/college/board.
  • Bihar Board Class 10 Result of all stream Result will be released on / OR before 31 March 2026 together.
  • Candidates can also check their subject wise result of the exam.
  • Stream Wise Toppers information will also be released by the Bihar Board.



Bihar Board 10th Matric Results 2026 Last Years Details

  • In the year 2026 of Bihar Board BSEB Matric Class 10, a total 81.79% students passed.
  • In the year 2025 of Bihar Board BSEB Matric Class 10, a total 82.11% students passed.
  • In the year 2024 of Bihar Board BSEB Matric Class 10, a total 82.91% students passed.
  • In the year 2023 of Bihar Board BSEB Matric Class 10, a total of 81.04% percent students passed.
  • In the year 2022 of Bihar Board BSEB Matric Class 10, a total of 79.88% percent students passed.
  • In the year 2021 of Bihar Board BSEB Matric Class 10, a total of 78.17% percent students passed.
  • The information about how many students passed in this year BSEB Matric Results 2026, how much percentage went in which stream will be available after the results of the examination are released.
